name: Hypertension
must_know: Diagnosis: confirm with repeat + out-of-office (ABPM/HBPM) before treating. Assess absolute CVD risk (Aus CVD Risk Calculator) not BP alone. Lifestyle first, then pharmacotherapy per risk. 2026 Australian HTN guideline due Q4 2026 (Heart Foundation/Stroke Foundation/Hypertension Australia) - watch for threshold changes.
should_know: White coat hypertension; resistant HTN; secondary causes screening (young <40, sudden, resistant: renin, aldosterone, renal artery, sleep apnoea, drugs).

name: Ischaemic heart disease and ACS
must_know: Secondary prevention post-ACS per 2025 Australian ACS guideline; angina assessment; stress testing limitations. Primary prevention: absolute risk approach. Statins intensity by risk.
should_know: Aspirin primary prevention NOT routinely recommended; antiplatelet + DOAC combinations.

name: Atrial fibrillation
must_know: Screen opportunistically by pulse/ECG in >65y. CHA2DS2-VA (Australian 2018 guideline dropped the sex category) for stroke risk. Anticoagulate (DOAC preferred) when score >=2 (>=1 in some); rate vs rhythm control.
should_know: DOAC selection with renal impairment; bleeding risk discussion; alcohol as precipitant.

name: Heart failure
must_know: Diagnosis: BNP/NT-proBNP + echo. HFrEF quadruple therapy: ACEi/ARB or ARNI, beta blocker, MRA, SGLT2i. Acute decompensation red flags.
should_know: When MBS-supported chronic disease management plan items apply.

name: Asthma
must_know: Diagnosis: variable airflow obstruction (spirometry with reversibility). Australian Asthma Handbook (NAC): SABA-only treatment is OUT - every patient with a diagnosis needs ICS-containing therapy; ICS-formoterol as needed (AIR) or maintenance. Written action plan. Reliever overuse = review.
should_know: FeNO role; inhaler technique checks; exercise-induced bronchoconstriction.

name: COPD
must_know: Diagnosis: spirometry post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC <0.7. Lung Foundation Australia COPD-X consensus: smoking cessation is the only intervention that changes trajectory; pulmonary rehab; vaccinations; SAMA/SABA then LAMA/LABA + ICS if eosinophils/exacerbations.
should_know: Oxygen assessment; exacerbation management (steroids, antibiotics when indicated); non-invasive ventilation.

name: Type 2 diabetes
must_know: Diagnosis: HbA1c >=6.5% (confirm if asymptomatic) or fasting BGL >=7.0 or OGTT 2hr >=11.1, or random >=11.1 with symptoms. Management: lifestyle + metformin; ADD-STEP: early comorbidity-based agent choice (SGLT2i/GLP-1 for CVD/CKD/obesity); retinal + foot + ACR screening annually; individualised HbA1c target (generally <=7%).
should_know: GLP-1 agonist practicalities; insulin initiation; steroid-induced hyperglycaemia; driving standards (Austroads) for insulin-treated drivers.

name: Thyroid disease
must_know: TSH-first testing. Overt: treat. Subclinical: repeat 6-8 weeks, TPO antibodies; treat hypothyroidism if TSH >10 or pregnant/infertility. Thyroid nodule: check TSH, ultrasound, FNA per malignancy risk.
should_know: Amiodarone thyroid effects; post-partum thyroiditis; levothyroxine absorption (iron, calcium).

name: Chronic kidney disease
must_know: Staging: eGFR category (G1-G5) + albuminuria (A1-A3). eGFR <60 for >3 months, or ACR >=3 mg/mmol persistently. Kidney Health Australia: BP control, RAAS blockade if albuminuria, SGLT2i, avoid nephrotoxins (NSAIDs, dehydration + contrast). Refer nephrology per criteria (eGFR <30, rapid decline, proteinuria, haematuria).
should_know: Medication dose adjustment by eGFR; sick day rules.

name: Osteoporosis
must_know: First Fracture Prevention: any low-trauma fracture after 50 = investigate (DEXA) and treat. Calcium (diet) + vitamin D + resistance exercise; bisphosphonate first-line; treat 3-5 years then reassess. Secondary causes screen.
should_know: Glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis prevention; denosumab practicalities (must not delay next dose).

name: Depression and anxiety
must_know: Screen (PHQ-9, GAD-7, K10); suicide risk assessment (thoughts, plan, means, intent, protective factors). Stepped care: psychological therapy first for mild-moderate; add SSRI for moderate-severe. Review 2 weeks then 4-6 weeks. Black dog Institute/RACGP guidance.
should_know: Perinatal mental health; older persons depression; IPT; medication interactions (SSRI + tramadol = serotonin syndrome).

name: Suicide risk assessment
must_know: Ask directly. Safety planning (not no-suicide contracts). Means restriction. Lethality: plan/intent/access. Involve mental health service, safety net carers, remove access. Document.
should_know: QLD pathways: Mental Health Line 1300 642 255; ED vs community options; Mental Health Act QLD involuntary assessment criteria.

name: Contraception
must_know: UKMEC categories; LARC first-line discussion (implant, IUDs); copper IUD = emergency contraception most effective; ulipristal 5 days; levonorgestrel 120h weight caveat (efficacy reduced >70-80 kg). Prescribing: BP, history.
should_know: IUD insertion pathways; Quick start; missed pill rules; contraception in perimenopause.

name: Menopause and perimenopause
must_know: MHT indications/contraindications; timing hypothesis (window of opportunity <60y or <10y since menopause); vaginal oestrogen for GSM; bone protection.
should_know: Non-hormonal options; compounded hormones NOT recommended (menopause society position).

name: Skin cancer
must_know: Australia: highest melanoma incidence. ABCD/E + ugly duckling + change; NMSC (BCC/SCC) common. Biopsy rules: excision 2mm BCC, 2mm + 4mm SCC margins (in practice refer face/large); photography for surveillance; total body skin exam.
should_know: Melanoma risk factors (naevi, family, colouring); 3 monthly self-check; cryotherapy limits.

name: Antimicrobial stewardship and common infections
must_know: Therapeutic Guidelines (eTG) is the reference. Common: UTI (nitrofurantoin first-line uncomplicated), cellulitis (flucloxacillin), community pneumonia (amoxycillin; doxycycline if atypical cover), impetigo, otitis media (watchful waiting), sinusitis, strep pharyngitis (penicillin). Penicillin allergy de-labelling.
should_know: Resistance patterns (QLD); when to swab; MRSA coverage; clindamycin resistance for Group A strep pharyngitis in far north QLD (empiric benzylpenicillin safe).

name: Immunisation
must_know: NIP Schedule (current: 21vPCV replacing 13vPCV/23vPPV in adults from mid-2026; RSV program; MenB with paracetamol prophylaxis). AIR checking; catch-up rules; valid contraindications (anaphylaxis, immunosuppression live vaccines); timing with other vaccines.
should_know: ATAGI statements; vaccine errors management; adverse event reporting; pregnancy vaccination (influenza, pertussis 20-32w, COVID).

name: HIV and sexual health
must_know: Australian STI Management Guidelines for GPs; ASHM. Screening by risk; contact tracing; test of choice by site (NAAT first void urine etc). HIV: treat all diagnosed (same-day start after confirmatory), PrEP eligibility (gay/bisexual men, trans, heterosexual with risk) - PBS-listed; PEP within 72h.
should_know: HIV indicator conditions; syphilis interpretation (avoid the prozone); neonatal STI.

name: Anticoagulation
must_know: DOACs first-line for AF/VTE in eligible; renal dosing; perioperative management (stop timing by bleeding risk); reversal agents; warfarin for mechanical valves. VTE treatment duration: provoked 3 months, unprovoked >=3 months then reassess; cancer-associated = indefinite.
should_know: Bleeding risk scores; aspirin+anticoagulant = avoid unless recent ACS/stent.

name: Stroke and TIA
must_know: FAST recognition; call 000 - thrombolysis/thrombectomy windows are time-critical (4.5h/24h). TIA = urgent assessment (same day) - ABCD2 not for triage in Australia; risk of early stroke post-TIA. Post-stroke secondary prevention.
should_know: Carotid imaging; AF detection post-stroke; aspirin + clopidogrel dual for minor stroke.

name: Headache: migraine
must_know: Diagnostic criteria (5 attacks, 4-72h, 2 of 4 features, 1 of 2 nausea/photo); triptans acute (not with aura-only? safe), prophylaxis if >=4 days/month (propranolol, amitriptyline, topiramate); contraceptive caveats with aura (avoid oestrogen if migraine with aura).
should_know: CGRP antagonists (PBS restricted); medication-overuse headache.

name: Inflammatory bowel disease and functional GI
must_know: IBD red flags (nocturnal symptoms, weight loss, PR bleeding, family history) - refer; exclude infection (stool MC&S) before steroids. IBS: positive diagnosis (Rome IV), dietary steps, low FODMAP diet with dietitian.
should_know: 5-ASA, biologics overview; colonoscopic surveillance.

name: Liver disease
must_know: NAFLD/MASLD: commonest chronic liver disease; diagnose by exclusion + fibrosis assessment (FIB-4, elastography). Viral hepatitis B and C: test (estimated undiagnosed cohorts), hepatitis C = curable (direct-acting antivirals, PBS), screen for cirrhosis (all HCV), hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance 6-monthly ultrasound if cirrhotic.
should_know: Vaccination (Hep A/B in chronic liver disease); alcohol thresholds; fibroscan access.

name: Coeliac disease
must_know: Test BEFORE gluten-free diet: tTG-IgA + total IgA. Biopsy confirm (adults). 6-12 monthly review; DEXA, vaccinations (pneumococcal).
should_know: Dermatitis herpetiformis; family screening.

name: Obesity
must_know: BMI class + waist; stigma-free care; 5-10% weight loss goals; GLP-1 pharmacotherapy now PBS for eligible (semaglutide criteria); multidisciplinary referral; bariatric surgery criteria (BMI >=35 with comorbidity).
should_know: Obesity as chronic disease; weight cycling.

name: Lipids
must_know: Absolute CVD risk drives statin prescribing (2023 Australian Guideline: assess 45-74 from 30 in ATSI, consider >75). Statins: high-intensity for established CVD, high risk, diabetes >=50 (or with risk); familial hypercholesterolaemia red flags (LDL >5 mmol/L, family) - refer.
should_know: Statin myalgia management (rechallenge/alternate); ezetimibe; PCSK9i access.

name: Prostate and mens health screening
must_know: PSA: shared decision-making, no population screening program (RACGP recommends AGAINST organised screening; discuss harms/benefits from 50, 40 if family history or ATSI). Erectile dysfunction: assess CVS risk (ED = marker). Testicular - no routine screening. Health checks and mental health/suicide risk in men.
should_know: Lower urinary tract symptoms treatment ladder; active surveillance.

name: Ophthalmology in general practice
must_know: Red flags: acute vision loss = same-day ED/ophthalmology (GCA, retinal artery occlusion, CRAO), acute angle closure, chemical injury (irrigate first), penetrating injury (shield, nil by mouth, ED), contact lens keratitis. Diabetes retinal screening; glaucoma opportunistic.
should_know: Red eye triage tree; fluorescein use; trichiasis.

name: ENT and oral health
must_know: Otitis media management (watchful waiting; when abx); sore throat (centor criteria); epistaxis first aid; hearing loss patterns (Rinne/Weber); nasal steroids for sinusitis; oral cancer red flags (non-healing ulcer >3 weeks).
should_know: Tonsillectomy criteria; grommets; vertigo ENT causes.

name: Child development and behavioural problems
must_know: Developmental milestones red flags at each age; surveillance vs screening; ASD/ADHD pathways in QLD; school refusal; enuresis (behavioural first, alarms); constipation (disimpaction then maintenance - PEG).
should_know: FASD; prematurity follow-up; child health nurse partnership.

name: Common paediatric conditions
must_know: Bronchiolitis (supportive, no bronchodilators/steroids/antibiotics per RCH CPG), croup (dexamethasone 0.15 mg/kg), URTI, gastroenteritis (oral rehydration, no routine antiemetics - ondansetron single dose may reduce admission in selected; zinc/rotavirus vaccine), febrile convulsion advice, eczema (steroid ladder, bleach baths).
should_know: Intussusception; appendingitis in young children; UTI collection methods.

name: Older persons comprehensive care
must_know: 75+ health assessment; polypharmacy review (deprescribing); falls assessment (orthostatic BP, vision, home hazards, vitamin D if deficient); cognition assessment (cognitive screen then...); elder abuse screen; driving (Austroads: dementia standards, on-road assessment); end-of-life planning; RACF and aged care standards; Silver Book (Medical care of older persons in RACFs) as the reference.
should_know: Aged care GP programs (including 2024+ funding model); delirium prevention; sarcopenia.

name: Palliative care
must_know: Terminal care in the home/RACF; symptom control basics (Palliative Care Australia, Therapeutic Guidelines Palliative Care): pain ladder, nausea, breathlessness, secretions, delirium; anticipatory prescribing; Recognising the dying phase (imminent death signs); Carer support; Therapeutic Guidelines: palliative version available free via RACGP.
should_know: Palliative care referral criteria; MBS items for palliative; MTGP planning (voluntary assisted dying - QLD legal since 2023: eligibility, process, safeguards).

name: Alcohol and other drugs
must_know: Screening: AUDIT-C; brief intervention; alcohol withdrawal (CIWA-Ar, thiamine before glucose); opioid substitution (buprenorphine-naloxone PBS); methadone; safe opioid prescribing; overdose prevention; smoking cessation: brief intervention, Ask-Advise-Help; pharmacotherapy (varenicline first-line now PBS wide, bupropion, NRT); needle programs.
should_know: Cannabis legalisation QLD 2025 changes; vaping cessation; synthetic drugs.

name: Family and domestic violence
must_know: Ask directly, privately (never with partner/children present); safety assessment; LIVE-FRISK principles (Western Australia/Australian-adopted framework) or e-ki (for practise); White Book is the RACGP reference; mandatory reporting only for children (and QLD: adults in some contexts).
should_know: Duluth tools; referral pathways; reproductive coercion; strangulation risk.

unit: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health
name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health
must_know: Closing the Gap; annual 715 health check; cultural safety definition and practice; PBS CTG scripts for medicines; chronic conditions targeted support; specific high-priority conditions (diabetes, CVD from younger ages - risk assessment from 30y, kidney disease, rheumatic heart disease in some regions, otitis media, smoking rates, mental health, suicide); mums and bubs programs; acknowledge Country appropriately.
should_know: National Agreement on Closing the Gap; First Nations-led services (Community Controlled Health Organisations); CTG scripts bridging the gap with conventional registers.
nice_to_know: Local MM/Torres Strait context (Minjerribah/North Stradbroke Island community).
